{{Top|leg}}
'''Farsands''' was the capital city of [[Little Mon Cal]], a sovereign island in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], and the main headquarters of the [[Sailor's Union]].

==History==
C. [[517 BBY]], after the creation of the [[Sailor's Union]] in [[Bartyn's Landing]], the capital of the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], the Union forced [[Hugo Bartyn]], owner of most of the land in Lamaredd, to cede the second biggest continent, [[Little Mon Cal|Jotsen's Island]] to the aliens. Jotsen's Island became the sovereign state of [[Little Mon Cal]], and Farsand became its capital city. The Sailor's Union located their main headquarters, [[Landing Union chapter|Landing union chapter]], in Farsands.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

C. [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], the fugitive [[Byrch Dyshkava]] escape from the local jail of Bartyn's Landing and intended to go to either Farsands or [[Cape Regret]], another city of Lamaredd.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

C. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], a number of waiters in Farsand complained as apparently the Union was threatening them. At that point, corruption was an important problem in Farsands.<ref name="BL" />
